objective: Pick up the blue block using all available resources and learning from operator demonstration.
success_statement: MIM picked up and retained the blue block after Dave demonstrated the correct pre-grab position.
resources_used: C12 distance sensor with 123mm sensor-to-tip baseline
what_worked: Dave provided a correct physical demonstration instead of holding the block in the claw path.
MIM saved the demonstrated visual/servo pose as a movement-memory seed.
Closing from the demonstrated pose produced symmetric contact on both sides of the blue block.
Small lift and base-retention movements kept the block captured.
learned_rules: Do not ask the operator to hold the block during gripper movement.
Use the demonstrated pose as the preferred blue-block pre-grab alignment target.
Close in stages and inspect each stage before lifting.
Lift incrementally and validate retention after each movement.
For this block shape, symmetric side capture from a correct demonstrated pose is more reliable than blind center-hole hooking.
next_recommended_action: Ask Dave what to do next with the block, or propose a simple place-down target and learn controlled release.
